information_hierarchy.primary_signal: SAFE TO SPEND — a computed signal, not an account, wallet, or pool of money. Detailed management belongs to F09.

information_hierarchy.supporting: Goals and priorities carried from the setup draft, plus a short attention line.
information_hierarchy.action: SEE WHY, QUICK ADD, ASK JURNL, and the entry into ACTIVITY.
